routeAudit.method: Existing planar road graph; 1cm node snapping; 2m sample spacing; actual SurveyWorld ground and roadStrip bridge/road triangles for graph slopes. Raw DEM slope retained separately. Entrances, width, bridges and game colliders need in-game verification.
